name: Simple WYSIWYG
description: Lightweight client-side rich-text widget and formatter for plain string/text fields, with basic buttons and an optional single-line mode.
project_description:
A simple WYSIWYG editor for plain text fields, providing basic formatting buttons: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript, and subscript.

 Features 
 
 Provides the form field widget with WYSIWYG editor for plain text fields ( string , string_long ) 
 Provides the field output formatted, which renders the plain text field value with allowed HTML tags. 
 Per-field configuration of visible buttons and allowed HTML tags. 
 Uses the contenteditable attribute to edit, so no heavy JS editors will slow up the page load time.
